name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
description: Four turtles fall into the sewers and are befriended by Hamato Yoshi a Japanese man sent to New York who was forced to live in the sewers. One day he sees a strange green glow which transforms the four turtles into human-like creatures. Hamato (now Master Splinter) changes into a giant rat from the green glow and teaches the turtles the skills of the ninja as they team up with news reporter April O'Neil to battle against Yoshi's arch enemy Shredder and Krang, an alien warlord from Dimension X.

videos.title: The Great Crisis of the Super Turtles! The Saint Appears!
videos.overview: The Turtles explored the temple of the lost Muta Kingdom where they met the spirit of light called Crys-Mu, who was contained inside the Muta Stone. In reward, she gives the Turtles the ability to do the Super Mutation, which turns them from regular turtles into Super Turtles for three minutes. When all four Super Turtles turns into one, they turn into the all-mighty Turtle Saint. At the same time, Shredder and Krang manage to find the Dark Muta Rock as they try to awake the demoness Dark Mu contained inside the crystal.

videos.title: The Coming of the Guardian Beasts - The Metal Turtles Appears!
videos.overview: The Turtles, along with April and Splinter, go on a trip to Japan in order to help Kinzou Hattori, in order to get rid of a ghost haunting the Hattori House. At the same time, Shredder, Bebop and Rocksteady teleport themselves to Japan in order to steal the Tablet of the Seven Elements, so they can gain the powers of the Guardian Beasts.

videos.title: Turtles Forever
videos.overview: The 2003 Ninja Turtles find their 1987 originals captured and held hostage by Hun. The 2003 Turtles defeat Hun, and the Purple Dragons and rescue their classic originals and escape to the modern Turtles' Lair. Meanwhile, the Technodrome from the 1987 TV series along with Shredder, Krang, Bebop and Rocksteady are together again and fight both versions of the turtles. Meanwhile the classic Shredder, transports the Utrom Shredder back from the ice asteroid that he was sent to after the "Exodus" episode. The classic Shredder and Krang had no idea that the modern Shredder would turn against them and sets out to erase the entire Ninja Turtle Universe, starting all the way back to the 1984 Mirage Comic series to where the Ninja Turtles are as of today, including the 1987 TV series Turtles, the live-action turtles, all the comic book turtles, and the modern TV series Turtles.

videos.title: Under The Shell with The Shredder
Under the Shell with Krang and Slash
The Turtles - A Ninjatastic Look Back
Under the Shell with Baxter Stockman
Under the Shell with Usagi Yojimbo
How it All Began
videos.overview:
A very special adventure telling the story of how a famous Japanese warrior named Hamato Yoshi became a warrior rat, the leader of a green lean fighting machine of mutant turtles.

Also featured is the evil Shredder - he's big, he's bad and he's trying to find the all-powerful "Eye of Sarnoff" to enable him to wreak vengeance on our world and our green-skinned heroes.

Can the Turtles break from their Pizza eating long enough to save the world from the might of Shredder - or this time will evil win through?

videos.title: A Shellabration with Points of Articulation
videos.overview: Takes a look back at the Playmate action figures and features some nostalgic clips from TMNT toy commercials.

videos.title: A Shellabration of the Turtles Creation
videos.overview: New interviews with TMNT creators Kevin Eastman and Peter Laird.

videos.title: A Shellabration of the TV Sensation
videos.overview: Interviews with the creative team behind the show.

videos.title: A Shellabration of a Fan-Nomenon Sensation
videos.overview: Devoted and Die-Hard TMNT Fans Speak!

videos.title: Artist Interview with Scott Heming
videos.overview: Artist Scott Heming discusses his work on the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles series.

videos.title: Turtle Tracks
videos.overview: April O'Neil, ace reporter for Channel 6, investigates recent break-ins, allegedly by Ninjas, which have resulted in the thefts of numerous technologies. A chance encounter with a gang of thieves soon leads her to a bigger story when she is saved from the criminals by four Ninja trained, mutated Turtles.

videos.title: Enter: The Shredder
videos.overview: The Shredder kidnaps Splinter in an attempt to lure the Turtles to his own cause. In order to rescue Splinter the Turtles must enter the Shredder's mobile fortress and brave it's dangerous weaponry.

videos.title: A Thing about Rats
videos.overview: Baxter Stockman, a mad scientist, is showing an exterminator his new invention: a rat catching robot called Mousers.

videos.title: Hot Rodding Teenagers from Dimension X
videos.overview: Shredder experiments with the Inter-Dimensional Portal, hoping to contact Krangs' Rock Soldiers and prepare an invasion of Earth, but a group of fun-loving aliens called the Neutrionos, renegades in Krang's dimension, take advantage of the Portal's opening and use it to arrive on Earth.

videos.title: Shredder & Splintered
videos.overview: As Shredder lures Splinter into he Technodrome, this time with the promise that a weapon in his possession can restore the sensei to human form, the Turtles confront a giant-sized Krang, now in a new body, in the heart of New York City.

videos.title: Return of the Shredder
videos.overview: Just when the Turtles believe themselves rid of Shredder, tin-grin is able to persuade Krang to return him to Earth.

videos.title: The Incredible Shrinking Turtles
videos.overview: While practicing their martial arts in Central Park, the Turtles witness an alien spaceship crash into a small pond. The pilot warns them that they must find the three fragments of the Eye of Zarnof.

videos.title: It Came from Beneath the Sewers
videos.overview: While the Turtles and April O'Neil scour the city for the Second Fragment of the Eye of Zarnov, Shredder sheepishly reports to Krang that he has lost the First Fragment.

videos.title: The Mean Machines
videos.overview: After the batteries died in the alien crystal converger, Donatello, using spare circuits from the space ship, builds a tracking device to help locate the second fragment of the Eye of Zarnov.

videos.title: Curse of the Evil Eye
videos.overview: The Turtles are still on the search for the last fragment. Shredder finds the last fragment and connects all three to his helmet.

videos.title: The Case of the Killer Pizzas
videos.overview: Krang finally relents and provides Shredder with help in defeating the Turtles.

videos.title: Enter: The Fly
videos.overview: Frustrated at Baxter's latest failure, Shredder contacts Krang in Dimension X and demands that Rocksteady and Bebop be sent to aid him.

videos.title: Invasion of the Punk Frogs
videos.overview: Shredder plans to acquire more mutagen and create more mutants. An ion storm in Dimension X interferes with the dimensional portal.

videos.title: Splinter No More
videos.overview: Sensing Master Splinter's despair at his new life as a rat, the Turtles agree to use the small amount of mutagen that they have left to concoct a formula that will revert Splinter back into Yoshi.

videos.title: New York's Shiniest
videos.overview: Shredder learns that the police have created a robotic cop and plans to steal then clone it. April gets a tip about the new experimental cop Rex-1 and breaks into the lab with her news camera for an exclusive story.

videos.title: Teenagers from Dimension X
videos.overview: While cruising around Dimension X, the Nutrinos decide to buzz the Technodrome. The Nutrinos learn of Krang & Shredder's latest plan to destroy the Turtles.

videos.title: The Cat Woman of Channel Six
videos.overview: While experimenting with a matter transporter in his secret hideout, Shredder sends Rocksteady and Bebop to a nearby garbage dump. Through a series of mishaps, Rocksteady and Bebop find themselves in the Turtles' Lair.

videos.title: Return of the Technodrome
videos.overview: Krang, sick of Shredder's constant failings, resolves to return the Technodrome to Earth.

videos.title: Beneath these Streets
videos.overview: The Turtles learn the cost of slacking off when Splinter is badly hurt during a confrontation with Shredder.

videos.title: Turtles On Trial
videos.overview: The intentions of the Ninja Turtles are put to the test when a controversial TV-figure portrays our heroes as menaces to society.

videos.title: Attack of the 50-Foot Irma
videos.overview: Irma accidentally becomes gigantic and her naturally clumsy nature makes her a danger to the city.

videos.title: The Maltese Hamster
videos.overview: Gangsters are swiping all the antiques in town. And when they swipe most of our heroes, it's up to Donatello and April to find out why. Could Shredder be behind this?

videos.title: Sky Turtles
videos.overview: The Turtles go flying when the Shredder invents a gravity-altering device.

videos.title: The Old Switcheroo
videos.overview: The personalities of Shredder and Splinter are switched when a device is accidentally activated during a battle between the Turtles and their enemies. As Shredder plans the Turtles' demise and Splinter plans on how to get back to his body, everyone else is clueless.

videos.title: Burne's Blues
videos.overview: In the middle of a summer heat wave, someone is destroying all the air conditioners and taking all the city's freon. In the meantime, Vernon and Burne go looking for the Turtles, but find something else.

videos.title: The Fifth Turtle
videos.overview: A 14-year-old boy tries his best to help out the Turtles, but with some not so optimal results.

videos.title: Enter: The Rat King
videos.overview: Thompson assigns April to research the growing rat infestation. She is pursued by an army of rats and escapes on a passing city bus.

videos.title: Turtles at the Earth's Core
videos.overview: Dinosaurs invade the Big Apple. Befriending a young diplodocus the Turtles trace the invading dinosaurs to their source finding a lost world.

videos.title: April Fool
videos.overview: Emperor Aleister of Malicuria comes to New York City, bringing along a shard of Lydium 90 to the USA.

videos.title: Attack of the Big MACC
videos.overview: A robot warrior arrives from 400 years in the future in 20th-Century New York.

videos.title: The Ninja Sword of Nowhere
videos.overview: Krang's computers detect an alien metal on the surface of the Earth. Krang sends Shredder, along with an Alien Metal Detector, to the surface to find it.

videos.title: 20.000 Leaks Under the City
videos.overview: Still searching for a way to destroy the Turtles, Krang develops a super pump that he intends to use to flood the sewers.

videos.title: Take Me to Your Leader
videos.overview: Full of self doubt, Leonardo leaves the team. Michaelangelo, Raphael, and Donatello all take turns being leader as they try to figure out why the sun is getting smaller.

videos.title: Four Musketurtles
videos.overview: A bump on the head leaves Leonardo thinking that he is in 17th century France, and that he and his comrades are Musketeers.

videos.title: Turtles, Turtles Everywhere
videos.overview: Shredder programs the city's new garbage collecting super-computer to collect the Turtles. But when Shredder doesn't specify 'Ninja' Turtles, the super-computer collects them all! Turtles of the city of every shape and size are not safe.

videos.title: Cowabunga Shredhead
videos.overview: The Shredder thinks he's Michaelangelo after a computer malfunction.

videos.title: Invasion of the Turtle Snatchers
videos.overview: Aliens abduct Donatello and Rocksteady.

videos.title: Camera Bugged
videos.overview: A visit to Earth from a Polarisoid results in havoc when Shredder comes into possession of the alien's camera, because it does more than just take pictures.

videos.title: Green with Jealousy
videos.overview: Krang sets his sights on a powerful Nuclear-Powered Submarine, believing it's fuel will be more than enough to power the technodrome.

videos.title: Return of the Fly
videos.overview: Baxter Stockman returns for revenge against the Turtles and Shredder, while our heroes attempt to stop Shredder's plan to siphon water from an underground reservoir.

videos.title: Casey Jones: Outlaw Hero
videos.overview: An eager vigilante is causing a stir in the city, while Krang and Shredder take control of all the machines in the city. Maybe this new 'hero' can help the Turtles.

videos.title: Mutagen Monster
videos.overview: In an attempt to hijack two separate trains carrying the ingredients needed to make mutagen, Rocksteady and Bebop cause their head-on collision, resulting in the spillage of both chemicals in the city's train yard.

videos.title: Corporate Raiders from Dimension X
videos.overview: High ranking corporate executives are kidnapped by men in business suits. The Turtles don't get involved until they learn that one of these corporations is the world's largest suppliers of pizza.

videos.title: Pizza by the Shred
videos.overview: Michaelangelo gets a job as a pizza delivery boy. But who's his new boss?

videos.title: Super Bebop & Mighty Rocksteady
videos.overview: Shredder and Krang produce hi-tech versions of Rocksteady and Bebop to keep the Turtles busy.

videos.title: Beware the Lotus
videos.overview: A skilled, and lovely, ninja warrior is hired by Krang to defeat the Turtles. Shredder's replaced, Leonardo's met his match.

videos.title: Blast from the Past
videos.overview: Splinter suffers amnesia as the Turtles try to remind him that he is the true leader of the Foot Clan.

videos.title: Leatherhead: Terror of the Swamp
videos.overview: While Raphael is reliving the past, via the Turtles' photo album, their frog friends in the Florida Swamps are being terrorized by a mutant alligator known as Leatherhead.

videos.title: Michaelangelo's Birthday
videos.overview: It's Michaelangelo's birthday, but none of his brothers seem to remember, and it frustrates him greatly.

videos.title: Usagi Yojimbo
videos.overview: A rabbit ronin warrior from an alternate dimension is lost in our world. While the Turtles help him adjust, Shredder steals a dragon egg to unleash it on the city.

videos.title: Case of the Hot Kimono
videos.overview: Someone is stealing all the kimonos in the city. After Master Splinter's favorite kimono is stolen, April's famous detective aunt helps the Turtles retrieve it.

videos.title: Usagi Come Home
videos.overview: Shredder tricks Usagi Yojimbo into battling the Turtles.

videos.title: The Making of Metalhead
videos.overview: While the Turtles are suffering from turtle pox, a disease that affects only mutant Turtles, Krang has developed a robotic turtle that he calls Metalhead.

videos.title: Leatherhead Meets the Rat King
videos.overview: Leatherhead has come to the city searching for the Turtles. While crawling through the sewers he encounters the Rat King who charges him with trespassing.

videos.title: The Turtle Terminator
videos.overview: Irma is kidnapped by Bebop and Rocksteady and is replaced by a robot that looks just like her that is programmed to eliminate the turtles.

videos.title: The Great Boldini
videos.overview: The Turtles must clear their names when they are believed to be jewel thieves who stole a priceless emerald during a magic act run by a wizard named Boldini.

videos.title: The Missing Map
videos.overview: Zach and his brother Walt visit the Turtles. As they leave, Walt takes a map that could guide Shredder to the lair if it happens to fall into the wrong hands.

videos.title: The Gang's All Here
videos.overview: Shredder tries to trick the Turtles into eating cookies made with anti-mutagen. Michaelangelo, wanting to be a human, tries one of the cookies and it mutates him into a teenager.

videos.title: The Grybyx
videos.overview: Kala's pet Grybyx, which has a really bad temper whenever it gets hungry, escapes from Dimension X through a portal to Earth, causing trouble for the Turtles.

videos.title: Mister Ogg Goes to Town
videos.overview: While searching for a device to transform crude oil into liquid hydrogen, Krang accidentally brings Mr. Ogg from Dimension Z to earth.

videos.title: Shredderville
videos.overview: The Turtles are frustrated that they let Shredder slip away from them again. They feel like giving up, and wish they had never been born.

videos.title: Bye Bye Fly
videos.overview: An interdimensional alien spacecraft leads Baxter Stockman to his latest vengeful plot to destroy the Turtles and Shredder.

videos.title: The Big Rip Off
videos.overview: After several failed attempts to get the Technodrome re-energized, Shredder and Krang run one last-ditch distraction for the Turtles at Fort Charles while Bebop and Rocksteady steal energy fuel cells from the neighboring space research center.

videos.title: The Big Break In
videos.overview: The Technodrome is up and running again, and it is up to the Turtles to hinder Shredder and Krang from getting to the surface.

videos.title: The Big Blow Out
videos.overview: After several setbacks, Shredder and Krang steal all of New York's electricity and charge it into a giant transdimensional gateway, designed to send Earth into Dimension X. The Turtles must defeat their enemies once and for all before Earth is destroyed by Krang's Rock Soldier army.

videos.title: Plan Six From Outer Space
videos.overview: With the Technodrome in serious need for new equipment, Bebop and Rocksteady are sent to Earth, disguised in human form, to capture the Channel 6 building and return it to Dimension X.

videos.title: Turtles of the Jungle
videos.overview: A professor's new ray-gun causes plants to go wild and his pet ape Jocko to become a giant rampaging monkey. By using the same ray-gun, Donatello is increased to Jocko's size so he can fight the giant ape and save April from him.

videos.title: Michaelangelo Toys Around
videos.overview: While trying to see the new toys at the Toy Fair, Michaelangelo stumbles upon a plot to take over a noted toy company.

videos.title: Peking Turtle
videos.overview: The Turtles must battle a reanimated Terracotta Army after Shredder steals an energy device shaped like a giant pearl, which is held and guarded by a Jade Dragon.

videos.title: Shredder's Mom
videos.overview: New York is in the middle of an induced heat wave caused by Shredder, who must battle the Turtles and deal with his mother, Miyoko Saki, at the same time.

videos.title: Four Turtles and a Baby
videos.overview: When General Tragg and his troops attack the Neutrino capital, the Neutrino leaders, Zenter and Gizzla, send their infant daughter Tribble through a portal to Earth, asking the Turtles to look after her, but Tribble causes big trouble for our heroes.

videos.title: Turtlemaniac
videos.overview: An eccentric billionaire, Monroe Q. Flem, who is also a collector, wishes to collect every piece of TMNT memorabilia that he can get his evil hands on, including April and the Turtles themselves.

videos.title: Rondo in New York
videos.overview: Shredder, Bebop, and Rocksteady are in town to steal a rare new mutagen created by Oswald Dren, a grad student. Some mutagen is accidentally spilled onto a reel of movie film causing monsters to come to life.

videos.title: Planet of the Turtles
videos.overview: The Turtles must save the Earth from a massive energy drain and its Apocalyptic result by traveling to another dimension where turtles are the dominant species.

videos.title: Name That Toon
videos.overview: A Technodrome computer disguised as an electronic keyboard ends up on Earth, and in the most unlikely of hands.

videos.title: Menace, Maestro Please
videos.overview: The Turtles must contend with the "Phantom of the Floxy" while trying to hinder Shredder's latest plan to bring the Technodrome back to earth.

videos.title: Superhero for a Day
videos.overview: Gadget Man comes out of retirement after 50 years, but is tricked by Shredder into fighting against the Turtles.

videos.title: Back to the Egg
videos.overview: Krang hires a multi-dimentional ring-master who intends on making the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles part of his circus by using an anti-aging serum.

videos.title: Son of Return of the Fly II
videos.overview: Vengeful Baxter Stockman and an A.I. computer return to Earth from a dimentional limbo and capture the Turtles while luring Shredder into their trap as well.

videos.title: Raphael Knocks 'em Dead
videos.overview: Raphael must contend with a mobster named Pinky McFingers when he is kidnapped from a local comedy club.

videos.title: Bebop and Rocksteady Conquer the Universe
videos.overview: On their latest trip to Earth, Bebop and Rocksteady steal a machine that makes everyone scared of everything.

videos.title: Raphael Meets His Match
videos.overview: Raphael wins a ticket to a costume party on MacDonald Crump's yacht and decides to go disguised as a Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtle.

videos.title: Slash the Evil Turtle from Dimension X
videos.overview: Bebop and Rocksteady use Krang's new Mutagen on Bebop's pet turtle Slash so he can do their housework for them. Slash runs away and is conned by an irritated entrepreneur into framing the TMNT.

videos.title: Leonardo Lightens Up
videos.overview: A ray-gun makes Leonardo carefree and ignore his responsibilities. This leaves the Turtles defenseless and the city at the mercy of Maestro G Clef, a villain who destroys the city with music.

videos.title: Were-Rats from Channel 6
videos.overview: After many failed attempts from his rodent subjects to find food, the Rat King learns of an abandoned canister of mutagen lost in the sewers and claims it for himself.

videos.title: Funny, They Shrunk Michaelangelo
videos.overview: While Michaelangelo is testing out a sailboard in the sewers he accidentally gets swept out into the city harbor.

videos.title: The Big Zipp Attack
videos.overview: Krang sends Shredder, Bebop and Rocksteady to find Rigidium to repair the Technodrome. A meteorite lands containing a large egg. The egg hatches, revealing a Zipp, a cute little creature that begins to eat the Technodrome.

videos.title: Donatello Makes Time
videos.overview: Professor Lloyd Cycloyd, a crazy scientist who escaped from an institution, accidentally discovers the Turtles' lair. He sees Donatello testing out one of his new inventions, a time stopper.

videos.title: Farewell, Lotus Blossum
videos.overview: While on their way to a movie, the Turtles rescue the Urn of Chakahachi from two thieves. The thieves pry off a pearl from the Urn before the Turtles get their hands on it.

videos.title: Rebel Without a Fin
videos.overview: Dr. Polidorius creates a half-man half-fish named Ray. The Doctor has Ray plant explosives in certain parts of the sewer so that he can sink the city beneath the ocean.

videos.title: Rhino-Man
videos.overview: J. Gordon Hungerdunger, a Texas millionaire, is holding a best super-hero contest. The winner of the contest will receive the humongous Malaprop Diamond.

videos.title: Michaelangelo Meets Bugman
videos.overview: Michaelangelo meets his favourite comic book hero after he saves a weakened Brick Bradley in the sewers, and then he and Bugman take on the evil Electrozapper together.

videos.title: Poor Little Rich Turtle
videos.overview: Krang has come up with yet another brilliant plan to free the Technodrome. The evil alien sends Bebop and Rocksteady to kidnap Buffy Shellhammer, 15 year-old CEO of Shellhammer Chemicals.

videos.title: What's Michaelangelo Good For?
videos.overview: The Turtles go along with Michaelangelo and his pet pigeon to the zoo so that Dr. Goodfellow can check the bird out.

videos.title: The Dimension X Story
videos.overview: Disguised as humans, Rocksteady and Bebop are sent to attach special trans-dimensional thrusters to the Channel Six Building.

videos.title: Donatello's Degree
videos.overview: Donatello gets an invitation to accept his degree personally from Professor Sopho at Sopho University. The only problem is that the invitation is addressed to a Miss Donna Tello.

videos.title: The Big Cufflink Caper
videos.overview: The Turtles, bored at the lack of action, decide to investigate when they hear that cufflinks are being stolen around the city.

videos.title: Leonardo VS Tempestra
videos.overview: The Turtles sneak into an arcade in the middle of the night to play video games. Leonardo gets hooked on a game called Tempestra's Revenge.

videos.title: Splinter Vanishes
videos.overview: Returning from another mission, the  Turtles are shocked to discover their mentor has left the lair, leaving behind only a video taped message.

videos.title: Raphael Drives 'Em Wild
videos.overview: On his way home from getting pizza Raphael and a cab driver accidentally get exposed to rays from a Personality Transmogrifier.

videos.title: Beyond the Donatello Nebula
videos.overview: Donatello has created a device to communicate with distant galaxies. While trying to communicate with the Turtle Nebula Donatello accidentally brings a spaceship to Earth.

videos.title: Big Bug Blunder
videos.overview: A fly lands in the mutagen and it increases in size. Not being able to control it, Bebop and Rocksteady send the giant insect to Earth.

videos.title: The Foot Soldiers Are Revolting
videos.overview: After Bebop and Rocksteady blow another assignment, Shredder fires them and decides to replace them with an intelligent Foot Soldier named Alpha One.

videos.title: Unidentified Flying Leonardo
videos.overview: UFO sightings at an upstate farm town known as High Falls, cause April to investigate. Splinter foresees danger clouding April's visit and sends Leonardo to chaperone.

videos.title: The Turtles and the Hare
videos.overview: In Krang's latest scheme, Rocksteady and Bebop, dressed as Easter bunnies, are blasting people with a Docilizer Ray and turning them into timid, rabbit-like people.

videos.title: Once Upon a Time Machine
videos.overview: Hokum Hare discovers that Shredder has a time train to travel to the future, where he can become crimelord of a crime-free era.

videos.title: My Brother, the Bad Guy
videos.overview: Shredder breaks into the Ninja Hall of Fame and steals the diary of the famous Brothers Kojima. He leaves his fingerprints all over the place though, and one Lieutenant Saki, Shredder's brother, finds them.

videos.title: Michaelangelo Meets Mondo Gecko
videos.overview: Michaelangelo awakes in the middle of the night from a bad dream. Unable to remember what it was about, Splinter assists him through hypnotism. Mikey vividly recalls the day that he and his brothers fell into the sewer and landed in the green ooze but he also sees a small lizard crawling through the contaminant.

videos.title: Enter: Mutagen Man
videos.overview: In the frozen tundra of the Arctic Polar Cap, Krang rants and raves that Rocksteady and Bebop will not return in time with the Bindex 3 to load the mutagen into the rocket ship's fuel tanks before lift off. Krang' plans turn all the City's inhabitants into horribly disfigured mutants from the vapor trails of the fuel used to lift the rocket.

videos.title: Donatello's Badd Time
videos.overview: While road testing the Turtle Van with his latest inventions, Donatello encounters a family of criminal hillbillies known as the Badd Family.

videos.title: Muckman Messes Up
videos.overview: Attempting to de-mutate the Turtles, Krang sends Shredder, Rocksteady and Bebop to the Earth's surface to retrieve Compound X-7.

videos.title: Michaelangelo Meets Bugman Again
videos.overview: Michaelangelo and the other Turtles go topside in an effort to find the latest issue of "The Adventures of Bugman", only to learn that the comic book has been canceled.

videos.title: Napoleon Bonafrog: Colossus of the Swamps
videos.overview: While Krang hires some local hoods to drill for anti-freeze Shredder, Rocksteady and Bebop visit the Louisiana Swamps in search of the Mutagen Pool.

videos.title: Raphael VS The Volcano
videos.overview: Thanks to a malfunction in Donatello's Healthometer, an invention designed to diagnose one's health, Raphael is convinced that he is not long for this world. Raphael decides to make the world a better place with what little time he has left.

videos.title: Landlord of the Flies
videos.overview: Baxter Fly is back, and this time he has assembled an army of flies to infest the city, endangering millions just so Stockman can get to Shredder.

videos.title: Donatello's Duplicate
videos.overview: Donatello decides to create a clone of himself so that he can spend more time on his inventions while his clone spends more time fixing things around the Lair. Donny tests his latest invention on a sewer rat and accidentally gets his hand in the way, causing the rat clone to talk just like Donatello.

videos.title: The Ice Creature Cometh
videos.overview: While the Turtles do battle with a refrigerator that has not been defrosted lately, Rocksteady and Bebop decide that they want to be the top mutants at the Technodrome and throw out a vat of mutagen onto the frozen tundra, creating a giant Ice Creature.

videos.title: Leonardo Cuts Loose
videos.overview: A series of baffling crimes are being committed by "brawny burglars" with thick Austrian accents and the Turtles are on the case, but so is Casey Jones and that could mean nothing but trouble for the Turtles.

videos.title: Pirate Radio
videos.overview: Krang's attempt to split the Inter-Dimensional portal goes awry. By utilizing the pirate radio station WOOF Krang believes that he can use the station to lure the City's populace into Krang's Chasm.

videos.title: Raphael, Turtle of a Thousand Faces
videos.overview: Raphael's ego is bruised when the other Turtles laugh at him for taking a correspondence class in the art of disguise. Raphael challenges his brothers to go to Central Park and pick him out of a crowd.

videos.title: Zach and the Alien Invaders
videos.overview: Zach, the Turtles' young friend, and honorary fifth Turtle, is infatuated with comic books, especially 'The Alien Invaders.' Zach retires his Turtle costume when his parents enroll him in the Ten-Hut Military Academy where they hope he will learn some discipline and live in the real world.

videos.title: Leonardo, the Renaissance Turtle
videos.overview: The City Mayor announces an end to crime when he introduces Professor Mindbender and the professor's latest invention: LEX, a robotic police officer. LEX rids the streets of crime enough to allow the Turtles to take a vacation.

videos.title: Welcome Back, Polarisoids
videos.overview: Krang wants to get a hold of the Polarisoids' camera. Krang sends a fake invitation to the Polarisoids to visit Earth, only the Polarisoids think that the invitation is from the Turtles.

videos.title: Michaelangelo, the Sacred Turtle
videos.overview: While the other Turtles go off to the local Planetarium to see O'Malley's comet, Michaelangelo visits the Natural History Museum with April O'Neil for the unveiling of the mummy of Ahmed Turt-el.

videos.title: Planet of the Turtleloids, Part 1
videos.overview: The turtles, Groundchuck and Dirtbag are taken to Shellri-La by an alien "Turtleoid" named Kerma. Kerma seeks help from the turtles to defend his planet from a two-headed dragon named Herman the Horrible.

videos.title: Planet of the Turtleloids, Part 2
videos.overview: The turtles unmask the dragon as they prove that the menacing creature is actually operated by two renegade Turtleoid delegates. Kerma return the turtles back to Earth, where they destroy Shredder's new Technodrome Mark II and afterwards defeat Chrome Dome.

videos.title: Rock Around the Block
videos.overview: Krang summons General Tragg from the Dimension X to keep the Turtles busy while Shredder places a remote control transmitter upon a rocket ship preparing to launch a satellite with a new super laser.

videos.title: Krangenstein Lives!
videos.overview: Under the Arctic Ocean Krang is tuning up his Robotic Body. While no one is looking, Bebop and Rocksteady inadvertently destroy an important computer chip and surreptitiously replace it with one from a video game.

videos.title: Super Irma
videos.overview: While the Turtles are busy trying to decide what costumes to wear to this year's Channel Six Halloween party, April and Irma are doing a story on the reverse polarity magnet at Magno-Dyne Labs.

videos.title: Adventures in Turtle-Sitting
videos.overview: While Splinter is away on meditative satori, Donatello sets his sights on solving world hunger. He invents the food revivafiver, a device designed to reverse the aging process of food.

videos.title: Sword of Yurikawa
videos.overview: Krang plans to blow up the Tri-State Bridge just as a convoy of trucks carrying a rare form of toxic waste passes overhead.

videos.title: Return of the Turtleoids
videos.overview: The Turtles go to the Top Notch Scientific Corporation to stand guard over the sonic disintegrator.

videos.title: Shreeka's Revenge
videos.overview: Shreeka, an alien with an attitude and a vendetta against Krang, after having spent eons tracking him down, has finally found him.

videos.title: Too Hot to Handle
videos.overview: Donatello tells the other three Turtles that, based on his calculations, the Earth has changed its orbit and is heading for the Sun.

videos.title: Nightmare in the Lair
videos.overview: Donatello's newest invention, the Dream-o-Vision helmet, causes Michaelangelo and Leonardo to be stuck in a nightmare world.

videos.title: Phantom of the Sewers
videos.overview: After another night's performance of the robotic Willie Wombat Revue at the Willie Wombat Revue Theatre, a mysterious figure, wearing a long black cape, black fedora, white face mask, and known only as the Phantom, makes an appearance.

videos.title: Donatello Trashes Slash
videos.overview: Donatello goes to Channel Six News to give Vernon a piece of his mind after he had made disparaging comments about Turtles on live TV.

videos.title: Leonardo Is Missing
videos.overview: When Donatello, Michaelangelo, and Raphael return from the video arcade they discover that Donatello's lab is in disarray and Leonardo is missing.

videos.title: Snakes Alive!
videos.overview: While practicing their martial arts, Leonardo tells Splinter that he is convinced that there is one combat maneuver he has yet to teach the Turtles.

videos.title: Polly Wanna Pizza
videos.overview: Michaelangelo returns from his sojourn to the pet shop with a monkey named Clyde. After only a few minutes with the undisciplined pet Leonardo, Donatello and Raphael demand that it be returned to the pet shop.

videos.title: Mr. Nice Guy
videos.overview: Burne assigns April a story reporting on the increase in urban crime. The only problem is that urban crime is decreasing.

videos.title: Sleuth on the Loose
videos.overview: While the Turtles are watching their favorite TV show April interrupts the broadcast with a special bulletin about a break-in at Dynamic Science Labs.

videos.title: Tower of Power
videos.overview: The Turtles and Splinter win a trip to Europe, but wind up riding in a crate with the Turtle Van. Meanwhile, Krang devises a giant electromagnet to pull the Technodrome free from an asteroid.

videos.title: Rust Never Sleeps
videos.overview: Krang works on an oxidizer rocket with enough power to blast the Technodrome to Earth, but something goes wrong, and instead of thrust, the device grows rust.

videos.title: A Real Snow Job
videos.overview: The Turtles are vacationing in the Alps, as Splinter goes off to a nearby mountain to meditate. April is in an Alpine village with Irma when she notices the ice and snow melting, unusual for this time of year.

videos.title: Venice on a Half Shell
videos.overview: Krang decides to use a hydrofluxer device to flood Venice, holding it for ransom.

videos.title: Artless
videos.overview: Two snobbish art-collecting aliens arrive in Florence and begin stealing great works of art.

videos.title: Ring of Fire
videos.overview: Krang sends Shredder to set up a special lens that will focus the sun's rays to create a devastating heat ray.

videos.title: The Irish Jig Is Up
videos.overview: Krang and Shredder decide to use Ireland as their base for the Technodrome. With a device called the Rainbow Trans-Charmer, the villains intend to turn harmless little creatures like sheep and rabbits into slavering beasts.

videos.title: Shredder's New Sword
videos.overview: In Dimension X Krang is using a long-range scanner and discovers a rare metal buried in a ruined castle in England. The metal turns out to be King Arthur's legendary sword, Excalibur.

videos.title: The Lost Queen of Atlantis
videos.overview: Shredder, Rocksteady and Bebop are searching for a valuable energy source in Athens and discover that it is April's new necklace.

videos.title: Turtles on the Orient Express
videos.overview: April is covering the revival of the Orient Express. Shredder is on the train with Rocksteady and Bebop carrying the supercharger, a device to accelerate the train to super speed.

videos.title: April Gets in Dutch
videos.overview: April is covering the showing of the world-famed Duchess Diamond. Krang wants the diamond, a flawless stone, to focus the rays on his laser dimension blade.

videos.title: Northern Lights Out
videos.overview: Eric Red, seizes both April and Professor Swenson's map to the underground volcanoes in Scandinavia to tap into the molten energy and melt the polar ice caps.

videos.title: Elementary, My Dear Turtle
videos.overview: The Turtles are in England, when they are taken back to the past, via an experimental atomic clock and must team up with Sherlock Holmes and Doctor Watson in order to get the clock back and return to the present.

videos.title: Night of the Dark Turtle
videos.overview: Donatello's Early Detection system sounds its alarm. According to Donatello's readings, the city has experienced a major vibration emanating from the Earth.

videos.title: The Starchild
videos.overview: While rummaging through the local junkyard the Turtles witness the crash landing of an alien spacecraft.

videos.title: The Legend of Koji
videos.overview: At the Museum of Fine Art Shredder uses his time portal to journey back to ancient Japan so that he can destroy Splinter and the turtles.

videos.title: Convicts from Dimension X
videos.overview: Thanks to a malfunction in Donatello's Inter-Dimensional Early Warning Detection Machine, a tear has occurred in the fabric of space and time, allowing two heinous criminals from Dimension X, Skaarg and Dementor, to arrive in the city.

videos.title: White Belt, Black Heart
videos.overview: Splinter is contacted telepathically by his sensei, Master Mogo-san who requests that Splinter meet him at Pier 17.

videos.title: Night of the Rogues
videos.overview: Krang, Shredder, Bebop and Rocksteady break in to the City Hall Records Department and steal maps of the sewer system dated 1895.

videos.title: Attack of the Neutrinos
videos.overview: While investigating the most recent robbery perpetrated by the Mole Squad, April and the Turtles stumble upon a secret meeting between the Mole Squad and Dr. Floyd O'Toole, a scientist who has been missing for weeks.

videos.title: Escape from the Planet of the Turtleloids
videos.overview: The Turtles visit April at Channel Six News and ask her if they could use the stations' equipment to contact their old Turtleoid buddy, Kerma, on Shell-Ri-La.

videos.title: Revenge of the Fly
videos.overview: Thanks to Vernon's irresponsible journalism, the Turtles find it necessary to stand guard at the Genetic Research Lab.

videos.title: Atlantis Awakes
videos.overview: While surfing in the white water rapids of the sewer, Michaelangelo is rescued by Merdude. Tthe Turtles, using Donatello's Porta-Tracker, volunteer to help Merdude find his way back home.

videos.title: Dirk Savage: Mutant Hunter
videos.overview: After an unsuccessful attempt at capturing Razar and Toka, the Turtles return to the lair to see the eccentric billionaire, A. J. Howard, spouting his ideology and his hatred for mutants across the airwaves.

videos.title: Invasion of the Krangezoids
videos.overview: Krang makes copies of himself and sets them loose to attack the turtles.

videos.title: Combat Land
videos.overview: There is a new amusement park in town and called Combat Land. The park's owner, Horatio Stressbar, has been unable to find anyone with the combat skills to give his robotic warriors a thorough work out.

videos.title: Shredder Triumphant
videos.overview: Shredder, Rocksteady, and Bebop arrive at the Asian arts exhibit and proceed to loot. The turtles head out to stop them despite a grave warning from Splinter that there will be dire consequences.

videos.title: Get Shredder!
videos.overview: Shredder & Krang are still loose on Earth, but without the resources of the Technodrome, they plan to steal equipment from the abandoned Hall of Science at the World Fair. Krang's former weapons engineer, Drakus, using the guise of Beserko, also shows up to cause trouble.

videos.title: Wrath of the Rat King
videos.overview: Burne has created a hot line for callers to use should they spot those responsible for the destruction of the Channel Six News Building. Inside the Hall of Science, Shredder is fearful that the Turtles will eventually find a way into the building and decides to seek out an old friend in the sewers: the Rat King!

videos.title: State of Shock
videos.overview: After defeating a mysterious group of ninjas at the Emeryville Power Station, the Turtles decode part of a map that they were able to liberate from the would-be thieves.

videos.title: Cry H.A.V.O.C.!
videos.overview: The Turtles get the drop on masked thieves hijacking a jewellery store, only to have themselves arrested for the crime! Before the turtles can be booked, they are rescued by the mutants Amok and Overdrive.

videos.title: H.A.V.O.C. in the Streets
videos.overview: Titanus sends of couple of his H.A.V.O.C. mutants to bust into the aerospace plant and steal some much needed equipment. Only problem is that the Turtles were waiting for them.

videos.title: Enter: Krakus
videos.overview: Krakus, a cop from the future, arrives and thinking that the Turtles are in league with Titanus, shakes them down for information.

videos.title: Cyber-Turtles
videos.overview: While investigating the theft of a rare telescope, the Astro-Viewer, the Turtles discover odd tracks leading away from the National Space Exploration Center.

videos.title: Turtle Trek
videos.overview: Krang activates his new dimensional portal, thanks to Shredder's installation of the Energy Transmitter at the Power Relay Station, giving him access to Dimension X.

videos.title: The Unknown Ninja
videos.overview: While watching video tapes of old battles, Raphael sees a mystery person spying on them. While the Turtles investigate, an alien warlord named Dregg sends his TechnoGansters to steal all the gold on Earth.

videos.title: Dregg of the Earth
videos.overview: April contacts the Turtles to let them know that Dregg has landed on Earth and is preparing a press conference. The Turtles rush to meet April at the Park, where they hear Dregg announce his friendly intentions and offers the world his molecular converter.

videos.title: The Wrath of Medusa
videos.overview: Believing that the Turtles are the only thing that stands between him and total domination of the planet Dregg makes contact with Medusa, a sinisterly beautiful alien.

videos.title: The New Mutation
videos.overview: After challenging Dregg to a final showdown, the Turtles find themselves on the losing end. Only this time, their new mutations have been captured on film and the world believes the Super Turtles to be evil monsters.

videos.title: The Showdown
videos.overview: April contacts the Turtles to inform them that all the TV stations in the City are jammed. Sleazebug tries to recruit the Turtles for a martial arts tournament.

videos.title: Split-Second
videos.overview: Carter, April and the Turtles investigate a break-in at the Antique Timepiece Museum. Convinced that Dregg is responsible, the Turtles discover a clue on a wall display.

videos.title: Carter the Enforcer
videos.overview: Splinter convinces the Turtles that it is their duty to fight evil, even when the whole world is against them. Carter and the Turtles team up with April to get the goods on Dregg.

videos.title: Doomquest
videos.overview: Dregg broadcasts his message to the citizens of Earth about the evil mutant Turtles. The Turtles mutate in broad daylight, attack a squad of Techno Gangsters, scaring the local citizenry.

videos.title: The Return of Dregg
videos.overview: While the Turtles work on using fragments of the Vortex Crystal to stabilize their mutations, Lord Dregg plans to use the fragments to create another Vortex Crystal to power his Vortex Transporter.

videos.title: The Beginning of the End
videos.overview: While Raphael, Michaelangelo, Donatello and Carter work on restoring Leonardo to his regular self, Mung steals all the plutonium from a power plant in order for Dregg to build a Plutonium Ray to turn Leonardo into a radioactive killer.

videos.title: The Power of Three
videos.overview: Mungg informs Dregg that he came across two individuals who claimed they were old acquaintances of the turtles: Shredder and Krang!

videos.title: A Turtle in Time
videos.overview: The Turtles', Shredder's and Krang's battles skills, powers, and memories are absorbed into Dregg.

videos.title: Turtles to the Second Power
videos.overview: Dregg and his crew plan an invasion Earth to make it his new home base, but first he has to get his transporter chip back from Shredder.

videos.title: Mobster from Dimension X
videos.overview: Dr. Alvin Huxley has demonstrated his breakthrough invention: a computer that thinks as fast as a human mind. The Globfather is on Earth and wants to get the protein computer for someone who is willing to pay a lot for it.

videos.title: The Day the Earth Disappeared
videos.overview: With the city breaking apart, the Turtles head to the street to investigate and see the Dreggnaut appear in the sky. With Mung's help, Dregg reprograms the transporter to open a warp in space.

videos.title: Divide and Conquer
videos.overview: Lord Dregg launches a final attack on the Ninja Turtles.

country: United States, Taiwan, Hungary, Philippines, Japan, China, France, South Korea, Ireland
